description: This file contains implementations for subtitle processing including normalization, correction, generation, translation, and validation functionalities. It defines multiple functions for manipulating subtitle files, intended as placeholders for a more sophisticated production system.

methods.name: str run_quality_check_and_correct( subtitle_path: str, video_path: Optional[str], language: Optional[str], enforce_ott: bool, processed_dir: str, )

methods.name: str generate_subtitles_for_video( video_path: str, language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a dummy subtitle file for a given video, simulating speech-to-text output.

methods.name: str translate_subtitles( subtitle_path: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str], processed_dir: str, model_hint: Optional[str] = None, )

methods.name: List[str] validate_subtitles(subtitle_path: str, options: Dict)
methods.description: Performs basic validation on subtitle files for line length, caption length, and emptiness.
